title: Warm tomatoes on toast with ricotta

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, crusty bread, ricotta and basil are all plain whole foods with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient, including ricotta and fresh basil, is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan and a toaster or grill, and the technique is simple frying and assembling.

works.reason: Six large tomatoes, 250g ricotta and four slices of toast make a sound light breakfast for four, though six sliced tomatoes will crowd one pan and soften rather than colour.

honest_times.reason: Ten minutes to slice six tomatoes and a garlic clove, toast the bread and season the ricotta is realistic, and the 3 to 4 minutes in the pan matches the five-minute cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item, including the basil and the split of the oil (2 tbsp in the pan, the rest to finish), is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Warm garden tomatoes are the heart of the dish and perfect for mid-August.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Tomatoes, ricotta and toast make a real-food breakfast with vegetables and protein that a family would happily repeat.
